finding.description: Untrusted model/agent output; render rationale as inert text.

ApprovalDecisionInput.description: Untrusted human choice; server resolves intent and authenticated approver.
ApprovalDecisionInput.title: ApprovalDecisionInput

action_intents.description: Oldest revision first; the last entry is current only if its case_revision equals case.revision.
action_intents.title: Action Intents

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back unchanged. Null at the end.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

ErrorResponse.description:
Body of every handled (documented) error response. `error` is a stable machine code;
no input is echoed. Unexpected server failures, proxies and network faults can instead
produce a non-JSON 5xx, an empty or invalid body, or no response: clients must fall back
to a generic message and, for an execution request, keep the same idempotency key.

details.description: Validation error codes only (no field names or values).
details.title: Details

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

ExecuteActionInput.description: Untrusted execution request; the key makes client retries return the original result.
ExecuteActionInput.title: ExecuteActionInput

replayed.description: True when this idempotency key already succeeded; the original action is returned and nothing is re-executed.
replayed.title: Replayed

rule_score.description: Recorded rule heuristic, not a probability. Null only for legacy transactions ingested before scoring outcomes were recorded (outcome unknown).
rule_score.title: Rule Score

intent.description: Built by the server from stored records.

InvestigationFinding.description:
Untrusted agent output. It selects among enumerated options only; the server builds
the action intent from stored records. Rationale is display text, never instructions.
InvestigationFinding.title: InvestigationFinding

InvestigationRequestInput.description: Untrusted request to investigate a case at the revision the analyst last read.
InvestigationRequestInput.title: InvestigationRequestInput

Money.description: Positive magnitude; direction is separate. Integers remain safe in JavaScript.
Money.title: Money

ScoringOutcome.description: The recorded decision for one ingested transaction, alerting or not.
ScoringOutcome.title: ScoringOutcome

SessionView.description: The authenticated session's own scope and permissions. Never the token.
SessionView.title: SessionView

TransactionInput.description: Untrusted input: no scope, source provenance, labels, actor or credentials.
TransactionInput.title: TransactionInput

info.description: Synthetic fraud-investigation workbench API. Scores are rule heuristics unless score_semantics says otherwise.
info.title: AgentForge Sentinel
